title: Recurrent Neural Network (RNN) — Telugu + English Learning
subtitle: Original English diagrams, tile headings, code and formulas unchanged. Modern Telugu + English questions and explanations.
hero:
RECURRENT NEURAL NETWORK · ILLUSTRATED OVERVIEW

An RNN reads new information while carrying forward its memory.

The changing hidden state is a learned summary, not a word-for-word storage system. Recurrent parameters are shared across all time steps.

questions.stem: Recurrent Neural Network (RNN) అంటే ఏమిటి? Text, Audio, Time-Series వంటి Ordered Inputsకి Feedforward Network కంటే ఎలా Differentగా Work చేస్తుంది?
options: RNN All Words Parallelగా Process చేసి Time Steps మధ్య Any Memory Carry చేయదు.
Feedforward Layers Previous Hidden Stateని Maintain చేస్తాయి; RNN మాత్రం Never Uses.
Feedforward Model Every Earlier Word Perfectగా Remember; RNN All Tokens Independentగా Works.
RNN Previous Hidden State Reuse చేస్తుంది; Feedforward Layersకి Built-In Recurrence ఉండదు.
questions.explanation: Simple Explanation: RNN Sequenceని Orderలో Read చేస్తుంది. Every Stepలో Previous Memoryని Next Stepకి Carry చేస్తుంది.
questions.technicalExplanation: Correct Answer: D. RNN Cell h_t=f(x_t,h_{t−1})గా Time Stepsలో Reuse అవుతుంది. Shared Parameters Sequential Dependencies Learn చేస్తాయి; Feedforward Architectureలో Built-In Recurrent Hidden State ఉండదు.
questions.figure:
01 · Basic architecture

A recurrent cell receives memory from the previous time step

Feedforward layers do not inherently carry a sequence state; the simple RNN does. Both can be parts of larger architectures.

questions.stem: RNN Hidden State అంటే ఏమిటి? Previous Time Steps Informationని Current Inputకి Carry చేసి Running Memoryలా ఎలా Use చేస్తుంది?
options: Hidden State Epoch Endలో Only Update అయ్యే Fixed Model Weightగా ఉంటుంది.
Hidden State Earlier Inputs Summaryగా Carry అవుతూ Each New Stepలో Update అవుతుంది.
Hidden State Training Labelని Store చేసి All Later Tokensకి Exactly Sameగా Remains.
Hidden State Every Past Word Perfectగా Forever Store చేసే Unlimited Memory అవుతుంది.
questions.explanation: Simple Explanation: Hidden State Running Notesలా ఉంటుంది. New Word Read చేసినప్పుడు Old Cluesతో Combine చేసి Updated Summary Create చేస్తుంది.
questions.technicalExplanation: Correct Answer: B. Hidden State h_t Fixed-Width Learned Vector; Prefix Informationని Summarize చేస్తుంది, Raw Words Perfect Copy కాదు. New Inputs Earlier Informationని Overwrite చేయవచ్చు.
questions.figure:
02 · What memory means

New inputs update a limited hidden-state summary

The words inside the capsules are teaching metaphors. Real states are vectors of learned numbers, not explicit text labels.

questions.stem: “The dog chased the ball” Sentenceలో RNN Words One by One Read చేసి Hidden Stateని ఎలా Update చేస్తుంది?
options: RNN Sentenceని Backward Only Read చేస్తుంది; Forward Order Process Possible కాదు.
RNN Every Wordని Fixed Dictionaryలో Store చేసి Hidden State Never Change చేస్తుంది.
Words Read, State Update; Earlier Context Later Predictionsని Affect చేస్తుంది.
Each Tokenని Separate Encode చేసి Earlier Contextని Every Stepలో Discard చేస్తుంది.
questions.explanation: Simple Explanation: First “The”, Next “dog”, Then “chased”… Each Word Hidden Stateని Change చేసి Context Build చేస్తుంది.
questions.technicalExplanation: Correct Answer: C. Initial h₀ Usually Zeros; h₁=cell('The',h₀), h₂=cell('dog',h₁), etc. Output Head Hidden Stateతో Classification లేదా Next-Word Scores Create చేయవచ్చు.
questions.figure:
03 · Step-by-step sentence reading

Each new word changes the memory used for later words

An RNN can learn relationships among subject, action and object, but it may lose details as a sequence gets longer.

questions.stem: hₜ = tanh(Wₓxₜ + Wₕhₜ₋₁ + b) Formulaలో Input, Previous Memory, Shared Weights, Output ఎలా Work చేస్తాయి?
options: Shared Matrices Current Input, Previous State Combine చేసి Hidden State Update చేస్తాయి.
Hidden State Current Word Only Use చేస్తుంది; Previous State Calculationలో Enter కాదు.
Every Positionకి New Recurrent Matrices; Shared Weights Completely Avoid చేస్తుంది.
RNN Token IDs Simply Add చేసి Activation Functions, Matrix Multiplication Skip చేస్తుంది.
questions.explanation: Simple Explanation: Current Input + Previous Hidden Stateని Shared Learned Matricesతో Combine చేసి tanh Apply చేస్తాం.
questions.technicalExplanation: Correct Answer: A. Elman RNNలో hₜ=tanh(Wₓxₜ+Wₕhₜ₋₁+b). Wₓ, Wₕ Same Across Steps; Output yₜ=Wᵧhₜ+bᵧ. Input/Hidden Dimensions Matrix Shapes Match కావాలి.
questions.figure:
04 · RNN equations

The current input and previous hidden state use shared learned matrices

This illustrates a basic tanh RNN. The output projection depends on the task, and PyTorch uses transposed internal matrix orientation.

questions.stem: Backpropagation Through Time (BPTT) RNNని ఎలా Train చేస్తుంది? Long Sequencesలో Vanishing, Exploding Gradients ఎందుకు వస్తాయి?
options: BPTT Long Gradient Chains Avoid చేస్తుంది; Vanishing, Exploding Problems Completely Gone.
BPTT Output Only Differentiate చేస్తుంది; Recurrent Weightsకి Gradients Never Compute.
BPTT Each Word Weights Randomly Change చేసి Past Steps Derivatives Ignore చేస్తుంది.
BPTT Time Steps Through Backward Gradients; Repeated Products Shrink లేదా Grow కావచ్చు.
questions.explanation: Simple Explanation: BPTT Learning Errorని Timeలో Backward Send చేస్తుంది. Many Stepsకి Gradients Too Small లేదా Too Large కావచ్చు.
questions.technicalExplanation: Correct Answer: D. BPTT Recurrent Computation Unroll చేసి Shared Weightsకి Gradients Accumulate చేస్తుంది. Jacobian Products Long Pathsలో Vanish/Explode అవవచ్చు. Clipping Exploding Gradients Limit చేస్తుంది; Truncated BPTT Compute Reduce చేస్తుంది.
questions.figure:
05 · Why gradients can fail

Backpropagating through many time steps can shrink or amplify gradients

The curves are conceptual, not measured results. Long chains of derivatives cause the training difficulty; clipping addresses explosions.

questions.stem: LSTM, GRU Gates Simple RNN Memory Limitationsకి ఎలా Help చేస్తాయి? Cell State, Update Gatesలో Difference ఏమిటి?
options: LSTM One Gate Only; GRU Four Separate Gates, Cell Memory Require చేస్తుంది.
LSTM Every Wordని Perfectly Store చేస్తుంది; GRU Past Information Permanently Lose చేస్తుంది.
LSTM Cell, Hidden Statesతో Gates; GRU Simpler Gates, One State Use చేస్తుంది.
LSTM, GRU Time Recurrence Remove చేసి Each Token Completely Independently Process చేస్తాయి.
questions.explanation: Simple Explanation: LSTM Gates ద్వారా Memory Keep/Forget Control చేస్తుంది. GRU Simpler Gatingతో One Hidden State Maintain చేస్తుంది.
questions.technicalExplanation: Correct Answer: C. LSTM Cell State c_t, Hidden State h_tతో Forget/Input/Output Gates Use చేస్తుంది. GRU Update/Reset Gatesతో Single State; Fewer Parameters Possible. Neither Long-Term Memory Perfect Guarantee కాదు.
questions.figure:
06 · LSTM versus GRU

LSTM manages a separate cell state; GRU uses simpler gates

LSTM has forget, input and output gates; GRU uses update and reset gates. Their exact speed and quality depend on the task.

questions.stem: Bidirectional RNN, Stacked RNN, Seq2Seq Architectureలు ఎలా Extend అవుతాయి? Transformersతో Parallelization, Long-Range Context Trade-offs ఏమిటి?
options: Transformers All Sequence Tasks Handle చేయలేవు; RNN Every Time Step Fully Parallelize చేస్తుంది.
Bidirectional Two Directions; Stacked More Layers; Seq2Seq Input–Output Sequences Map చేస్తాయి.
Bidirectional Forward Only; Stacked Memory Eliminate; Transformer Training Always Sequential.
Stacked RNN One Time Step Only Process; Encoder–Decoder Variable Output Block చేస్తుంది.
questions.explanation: Simple Explanation: Bidirectional Both Sides Context; Stacking Deeper Features; Seq2Seq Different-Length Sequences. Transformer Training More Parallel.
questions.technicalExplanation: Correct Answer: B. Bidirectional RNN Forward+Backward Context Requires Full Sequence; Strict Online Causal Tasksలో Future Data Available కాదు. Stacked Layers Depth Increase; Seq2Seq Encoder State నుంచి Decoder Sequence Generate చేస్తుంది. Transformers Self-Attention వల్ల Positions Parallel Train అవుతాయి, Cost Trade-offsతో.
questions.figure:
07 · Architecture trade-offs

RNN variants add context or depth; Transformers parallelize sequence training

Bidirectional models need future context, so they are not directly causal. Actual performance depends on workload, hardware, sequence length and caching.
